identity.canonicalName: West Elm × Emma Chamberlain Pleated Table Lamp (18")

classification.verdictNote: Designed by Emma Chamberlain with West Elm's in-house team. A limited edition sold only at West Elm.
classification.summary: A credited design from West Elm's 2026 collaboration with creator Emma Chamberlain, her first full home collection, developed with West Elm's in-house design team. It's an original, limited-edition piece sold only by West Elm, so there's nowhere else to buy it new. Chamberlain is a style figure rather than a lighting designer, so the name adds story more than design pedigree.

designer.name: Emma Chamberlain
designer.note: With West Elm's in-house design team

specs.label: Shade
specs.value: White linen, pleated and scalloped with red trim, 13.25 in dia × 7.4 in H

specs.label: Base
specs.value: Steel in chrome finish, 6.15 in dia

specs.label: Bulb
specs.value: One E12 (small candelabra) socket, 40W max or LED equivalent; not included; works with dimming smart bulbs

quality: A light, 18-inch bedside or desk lamp: a slim chrome stem on a domed base under a scalloped linen shade with red trim. It takes a small E12 candelabra bulb, not a standard one, so buy bulbs to match and expect soft rather than bright light.

The price buys the collaboration and West Elm's finish and service more than materials; at 3.1 lb it's a simple steel-and-linen lamp. It's limited edition, so it may sell out rather than go on deep sale.

retailers.label: Your link
retailers.notes: $159 each, or $318 for a set of 2 (no set discount). No promo on the page. Most items arrive in 4 to 5 business days.

maker.name: West Elm × Emma Chamberlain
paragraphs: West Elm launched in Brooklyn in 2002 with the idea of "great design at affordable price points" and is owned by Williams-Sonoma, Inc., alongside Pottery Barn and Williams Sonoma. Most of its range is designed in-house, with a steady run of named collaborations.

Emma Chamberlain, the creator and entrepreneur, launched her first full home collection with West Elm on March 30, 2026. It was designed with West Elm's in-house team and mixes mid-century and postmodern shapes with her personal motifs, and it's sold while supplies last.

items.name: MG&Co. (Matilda Goad & Co.) scalloped lamps
items.priceNote: UK site; lamp bases from £165, shades sold separately
items.why: The brand that started the scalloped-shade wave in 2016. Its lamps are heavier and more crafted than the West Elm lamp, but you buy from the UK in pounds, and its Anthropologie collaboration lamp is sold out.

similar.note: I didn't find a cheaper scalloped lamp with red trim that's decent quality; most matches were either more expensive or a different look.
